feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 25 October 2026 10:50pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 25 October 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds, increasing to gales later, bringing a risk of severe gales.


##Synopsis##

A weak ridge of high pressure will build temporarily, before a very deep area of low pressure tracks north of the British Isles, sweeping associated frontal systems across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

West 6 or 7, backing south or southwest 4 or 5 overnight, then then backing south or southeast 6 or 7 tomorrow morning, then veering south or southwest in the afternoon. Further increasing 7 or gale 8 in the evening, perhaps occasionally severe gale 9.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming mainly moderate for a time overnight, then rough or very rough from late evening tomorrow.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then rain at times tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 7 or gale 8, perhaps severe gale 9 at first, veering west or southwest 6 or 7 later.


##State of Sea##

Rough or very rough, soon becoming mainly rough, then moderate or rough later.


##Weather##

Rain at first, then showers.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor in rain, becoming mostly good.
